name: list_metrics
description: List the metrics that ALREADY exist in the LaunchDarkly app project (key, kind, tags). Use this BEFORE creating feature-specific metrics: LaunchDarkly autogenerates global observability metrics from the estate's telemetry (event keys prefixed 'otel' — HTTP 5XX error rate, average/P95/P99 request latency — and '$ld:telemetry:*'-derived browser metrics), and for NET-NEW feature paths those global metrics are the meaningful guardrails (a brand-new endpoint has no control-arm data of its own). Also useful to confirm a metric you plan to create already exists (reuse it instead).

prefix.description: Only metrics whose key starts with this (e.g. 'otel', 'ld_autogen__', 'enable-').
